$comment: T3 / FC3 / FC4: the ffmpeg sidecar is an LGPL build pinned by version and SHA256 per target. Change a pin only together with its hash.

source.note: No LGPL prebuilt exists for macOS (evermeet, osxexperts, Homebrew are all --enable-gpl), so macOS builds from source with scripts/ffmpeg/build-macos.sh.

x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.note: BtbN rotates old autobuild releases. If this URL 404s, mirror the pinned zip to this repo's own release rather than re-pinning to a moving 'latest'.
